courses.note: Elective: the degree requires no AI or ML course (it requires 23 hours of CS electives). CAP 4601 (cross-listed with CAP 5605) is the AI course with a recent public syllabus; it is not itemized in the program guide text. The syllabus covers traditional AI (knowledge representation, search, Prolog) and has no generative-AI or AI-use policy; AI appears only as course content.
